rationale: This mutation eliminates the $9,083 cash deficit by decoupling daytime capital reinvestment from excessive payroll buffers, enabling synchronous ramp to 8-10 plots by Day 6 and 16 plots by Day 11-12 to unlock 4-5 recurring Strawberry flushes. It closes critical revenue leaks by conditioning Town Shop seed procurement strictly on the presence of uncultivated vacant plots and banning slow single-harvest crops after Day 12, preventing high-yielding Strawberry acreage from being cannibalized. Finally, it implements well-refueled in-situ harvest-and-water micro-dispatch with non-blocking fallbacks to eliminate regrowth-freezing dry intervals, purges phantom livestock feed reserves to n_animals * 3, and locks an unyielding 0.82x liquidation price floor.
